Keep Your Greens Fresh and Your Waste Low 🥬🌽

Storing your veggies right might sound simple, but it’s a total game changer. Keeping them fresh longer means less food going to waste, more cash staying in your pocket, and tastier meals that actually make you excited to cook.

No more fridge mysteries or soggy salads! Plus, when you treat your food with care, you’re giving a nod to the farmers and the planet who worked hard to grow it.

It’s the small things that add up to big changes. Let’s make your veggies last longer — join the movement and store smarter 🌿

📖 Learn more veggie storage & revival tips on our blog:
👉 https://littlespoon.farm/storage-wilt-revival-tips/

I turned my rooftop to an urban garden thanks to my friend @audriaevelinn of @littlespoonfarm 🥰 

Udah lama banget aku mau punya kebun yang proper biar bisa terus manen sayur dan herbs yang bisa ku pakai buat masakan rumah. And finally that dream came trueee ☺️

Sekarang aku lagi nanam: cabai, timun, terong, tomat, jeruk2an,  pandan, ginger, turmeric galangal, and so much more ✨️ 

And I love that I get to teach my daughter the process of growing food, in the hopes that she wont ever take our sustenance for granted.

Next tinggal seriusin belajar permaculture in the near future!

P.S.

Support your local women-owned businesses, folks xx

Enjoy this (amateur) ASMR video of the making of Seaside, one of our favorite kitchen-made antioxidant drinks! Can you hear the satisfying sound when it’s poured into the glass? Combo that with the nature sound of our farm in the background!

We make Seaside using everything from the garden: dried butterfly pea flower, fragrant lemongrass, and a bit of sugar to balance the taste. Sometimes, less is more. Although containing very simple ingredients, did you know that butterfly pea flowers actually have many health benefits? Some research has found that this ingredient alone can help promote weight loss and balance your sugar levels. 

Seaside is also packed with antioxidant. It will make you feel refreshed during a hot afternoon, or after a long errand run! 

Ps. Seaside is featured in this week’s Farm Box, along with our best-seller, Farm Greens! (spinach, apple, pineapple, and lemons). Get the best of the both worlds now.
